Choices We Make.evidence: same title in BGEA's 'Billy Graham Classics'; the page says Tallahassee, 1986, and the transcript names Tallahassee

Getting a Piece of the Rock.evidence: same title; the page says Charlotte, 1972, and the transcript speaks of 'this community of Charlotte' and 'the great Charlotte Coliseum'

The Danger of Neutrality.evidence: same title (the page reads 'Billy Graham on the Danger of Neutrality'); the page says Sheffield, 1985, and the transcript says 'here in Yorkshire, Sheffield, England'

The Family.evidence: same title; the page says Toronto, 1978, and the transcript names Toronto

The Holy Spirit and You.evidence: same title; the page says Sacramento, 1983, and the transcript says 'here in Sacramento, California'

The Power of the Cross.evidence: same title; the page says Boston, 1982, and the transcript says 'here in Boston, Massachusetts'

The Real Meaning of the Cross.evidence: same title; the page says Hartford, 1985, and the transcript names Hartford

True Love.evidence: same title; the page says St. Louis, 1973, and the transcript says 'You cannot live pure in 1973 or 1974' (it names no city)

Truth and Freedom.evidence: same title; the page says New York, 1969, and the transcript says 'this great scene here at the garden in New York'

What You Cannot Do Without.evidence: same title; the page says Albuquerque, 1975, and the transcript says 'here at the University of New Mexico'

When God Gets Your Attention.evidence: same title; the page says Portland, 1992, and the transcript says 'a change in Portland'

Jesus Calls You by Name.evidence: titles differ: the page 'Zacchaeus' says Halifax, Nova Scotia, 1979, and the transcript says 'here in Halifax Nova Scotia', reads Luke 19 and names Zacchaeus 27 times

Almost Persuaded.evidence: same title; the page says the final evening of the 1962 Chicago Crusade, and the transcript speaks of 'this crusade', Illinois and McCormick Place in Chicago

Life After Death.evidence: same title; the page says the 1966 Greenville, South Carolina Crusade, and the transcript says 'many of you here in South Carolina'

Fools.evidence: same title; the page says South Bend, 1977, and the transcript says 'we're at the University of Notre Dame in South Bend, Indiana'
